articles.summary: PHP2Shell is an unauthenticated PHP remote code execution chain (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619) in PHP core. A deep dive into the use-after-free mechanism, mod_php vs PHP-FPM exposure, and how to verify you are patched.
articles.title: PHP2Shell Explained: How CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 Turn One Request Into RCE
